name: Cross-view Self-enhancement
definition: A strategy that uses the 3D consistent relevancy maps generated from the trained semantic field (refined with RSR) for semantic field training, replacing the view-inconsistent 2D semantics from CLIP to reduce ambiguity.
summary: Cross-view Self-enhancement is a training strategy that replaces inconsistent 2D labels with 3D-consistent pseudo-maps rendered by the model itself to ensure coherent multi-view semantic structures.
